description: A deterministic contract schema for defining obligations, deliverables, and termination conditions between autonomous agents.

parties.description: List of agents entering the contract with identifiers and capabilities.

obligations.description: Actions or deliverables each party must fulfill.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for obligations to activate or complete.

termination.description: Rules for ending the contract, including triggers and consequences.

workflow.action: Ensure all required contract fields are present and properly formatted.
Agents acknowledge and bind to the contract terms.
Obligations activate when conditions are met.
Contract produces a machine-readable summary of status and compliance.
